ValidationRule.description: If the Schedule date is blank for a payment record with the status as Scheduled.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( !$Setup.Bypass_Automation_Setting__c.Payment_Validation__c, OR( ISPICKVAL( Status__c ,'Scheduled'),ISPICKVAL( Status__c ,'Past Due') ), ISBLANK( Scheduled_Date__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please Enter the scheduled date for the payment.
